d:
Ishq is the absolute form of love. The kind of love where you don’t need the presence of the beloved. Love becomes enough in itself.
Ishq is the superlative form of love. An ideal form where you think of something and it happens. Ishq is love and longing romanticised by the poet.
On one hand Ishq is agony, passion and intensity. On the other hand it is peace, contentment and composure.
